test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word provided in the brackets to fill in the blank.

The painting exhibited a __________ blend of colours. (harmonious)
solution:
The correct answer is '**discordant**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**harmonious**" means forming a pleasing or consistent whole.
 
• The antonym of harmonious is "**discordant**", which means lacking harmony or agreement.
 
• The other options: "**quavering**," "**polyphonic**," and "**thrilling**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The painting exhibited a discordant__ blend of colours.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Quavering**: shaking or trembling in speaking, typically through nervousness or emotion.
 
• **Polyphonic**: producing many sounds simultaneously; many-voiced.
 
• **Thrilling**: causing excitement and pleasure; exhilarating.
